name: WENZHOU MAHJONG
description: Wenzhou Mahjong is a Zhejiang regional Mahjong variant associated with Wenzhou play communities. It uses the standard Mahjong draw-discard loop with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while table profiles define specific win validity and scoring emphasis.

content.text: Wenzhou Mahjong is a Zhejiang regional Mahjong variant associated with Wenzhou play communities. It uses the standard Mahjong draw-discard loop with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while table profiles define specific win validity and scoring emphasis.
Wenzhou Mahjong reflects regional table practices in Zhejiang and developed as a locally recognized scoring and validity profile within Chinese Mahjong traditions.
Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honor tiles, and bonus tiles according to table profile.
